summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Privileged lab-admin account (s.demir@aegean.edu) authenticated from a non-university Cloudvault VPS in Frankfurt, DE, via the flagged vulnerable VPN appliance vpn-edge-01. A single MFA approval at 21:31 was followed by seven consecutive MFA-free successes across portal and lms at 5-minute intervals (21:32–22:02), all with empty device_id. This pattern—foreign VPS, vulnerable appliance, one-time MFA then automated MFA-free access to multiple apps—is consistent with session hijack / MFA bypass and confirmed account takeover. Contain: disable the account, reset credentials, revoke all sessions, and investigate the VPN appliance.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
